scenes.text: Hello little friend! I'm Funny Bunny, and today we're going to hop into the world of nutrition. Do you know what nutrition means? It's all about the yummy foods that help our bodies grow strong and healthy. Are you ready to explore with me? Let's get our bunny ears ready for a fun adventure!

Now, let's start by talking about vegetables. Vegetables are like superfoods for our bodies, giving us the energy to play and learn. Have you ever tried a crunchy carrot or a leafy spinach leaf? These are packed with vitamins that help our eyes see better and our muscles grow stronger. Remember, every bite of veggies is like a little superhero helping you grow!

Let's learn how to make our plates colorful with fruits and veggies. Imagine a rainbow on your plate, with reds, greens, yellows, and purples. Each color means different nutrients, like vitamin C in oranges to keep colds away. Next time you're eating, see how many colors you can add to your meal. It's fun and super healthy!

Great job learning about colorful plates! Now, let's pretend we're bunnies munching on our favorite foods. Can you wiggle your nose and nibble like a bunny? It's important to eat slowly and enjoy every bite. This way, your tummy feels happy and full, just like a bunny's after a delicious meal!

Remember when we talked about carrots? There's more to explore in the vegetable world. Broccoli looks like tiny trees, and they help keep our bones strong. Have you tried peas? They're like little green balls of fun that help our muscles. Each veggie has a special job to help you grow, just like a team of tiny helpers!

Let's take a deep breath and think about water. Water is super important because it keeps us hydrated and helps our bodies work well. Imagine you're a plant, and water is your sunshine, helping you grow. Try counting to three as we take a sip of water together. One, two, three, sip! Feels refreshing, doesn't it?

Did you know that fruits are nature's candy? What’s your favorite fruit? Maybe a juicy apple or a sweet banana? Each fruit is packed with vitamins and fiber that keep our tummies happy. Next time you snack, try to pick a fruit and see how sweet and colorful it can be. Fruits are fun and good for you!

Let's hop back to proteins, like eggs, chicken, and beans. These foods help build our muscles so we can run, jump, and play. Imagine proteins as the builders in your body, making you strong and ready for adventures. Next time you eat, think about the strong muscles you're building with every bite!

Now, let's talk about grains like rice, bread, and oats. Grains give us energy to do all the fun things we love. Imagine grains as tiny fuel tanks that keep us going all day. When you eat grains, you're filling up your energy tank for lots of playtime. Can you think of your favorite grain? Maybe a slice of bread or a bowl of oatmeal?

You're doing amazing learning about all these foods! Let's pretend to be chefs, mixing and matching different foods. What if we mixed grains with some veggies? Or fruits with a little yogurt? Creating meals is like making art with food. You can do it, and it's so much fun!

Do you remember why we need to eat a variety of foods? It's because each one helps a different part of our body. Like how milk helps our bones and fish helps our brain. Can you think of a food that helps you feel strong? Eating a variety of foods is like having a team of superheroes keeping you healthy!

Let's not forget about snacks. Healthy snacks like nuts or cheese can give us energy between meals. Imagine snacks as little helpers that keep our energy up. Next time you're hungry, try reaching for a healthy snack. It will keep you energized and ready for more fun!

Finally, let's talk about listening to our tummies. When your tummy feels full, it's telling you it's had enough. It's important to listen and stop eating when you're full. This way, you'll feel comfortable and happy, just like a bunny after a big meal. Remember, your tummy knows best!

You've done a wonderful job learning about nutrition today! Remember, eating a variety of foods helps you grow strong and healthy. Keep exploring new foods and have fun with every bite. I'm so proud of you for hopping along with me on this adventure. Until next time, keep munching and stay healthy, little friend! Goodbye!
